test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Some characteristic features of autotrophs are listed below. Which of the given statements is INCORRECT with respect to autotrophs?

options.text: All green plants and some bacteria are autotrophs.
They are also called primary producers.
Carbon and energy requirements of autotrophs are fulfilled by photosynthesis.
The carbohydrates not used immediately are stored in the form of glycogen.

solution:
The correct answer is** The carbohydrates not used immediately are stored in the form of glycogen.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Option 4 is incorrect because** Autotrophs **store excess carbohydrates in the form of starch, not glycogen</strong
